verdict.rationale: Sentry has a documented web API and an official MCP server for AI assistants, and the MCP docs say a connection can be scoped so tools default to a constrained org/project with discovery tools hidden. That is a form of least-privilege access for agents. However, nothing in the evidence describes issuing API tokens with permission scopes, read-only or limited credentials, or agent-specific token management. Missing for 10: documented token/permission scopes for API credentials, a way to create least-privilege tokens for agents, credential lifecycle (rotation/revocation) evidence, independent corroboration.
